ui.title: Forgot/reset password · smoke · Primary data renders
ui.preconditions: Signed-out visitor or controlled identity-provider state; backing data Keycloak hosted forgot-credentials flow.
steps: Open Forgot password from the signed-out page using a configured identity provider.
Open the hosted Keycloak password-reset page and verify the email form loads.
Check the page-specific heading and primary control and confirm no private data is exposed to the wrong account.
ui.expected: The Forgot/reset password lifecycle screen behaves as expected: Open the hosted Keycloak password-reset page and verify the email form loads. No unauthorized workspace data is displayed.
ui.evidence: Capture screenshot on failure; retain Playwright video and trace on failure.

bdd.scenario: Forgot/reset password: a user submits a registered email
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When a user submits a registered email
bdd.then: Then the identity provider displays its configured reset confirmation without revealing account existence
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Keycloak hosted forgot-credentials flow and the configured Keycloak identity provider
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Forgot/reset password: a user submits an invalid email
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When a user submits an invalid email
bdd.then: Then the email field validation is displayed
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Keycloak hosted forgot-credentials flow and the configured Keycloak identity provider
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Forgot/reset password: a user submits an unregistered email
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When a user submits an unregistered email
bdd.then: Then the same safe confirmation is shown without account enumeration
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Keycloak hosted forgot-credentials flow and the configured Keycloak identity provider
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Forgot/reset password: a user opens an expired reset link
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When a user opens an expired reset link
bdd.then: Then the provider offers a safe retry path without changing the password
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Keycloak hosted forgot-credentials flow and the configured Keycloak identity provider
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.
